description: BUILD.md Phase 4 task 6: informal dev cases, re-run in all three privacy modes to record the first real accuracy signal per mode. Deliberately smaller than the Phase 6 evaluation dataset (50-60 semi-synthetic cases) -- four cases here, covering both committed form schemas, a complete case and an adversarial missing-field case for each, chosen to exercise every FieldType (identifier/date/location/name/numeric_financial) and both correct-fill and correct-abstention paths. Ground truth values map field name to the expected extracted string; a null ground truth means the field is genuinely absent from the evidence and correct behavior is to abstain.
